changes: Name kept as Rāmārādhya (normalising -ḍh- to -dh-), but 'ārāḍhya' removed from titles: the first reading counted it as both part of the name and a title. The alternative reading (name Rāma + title Ārādhya) is given in notes.
Confidence for p1 lowered from high to medium because the compound can be split in more than one way.
Year given as '[9]92' to show the catalogue's reconstruction of the lost first digit. ce_approx 1872 (992+880) kept but marked uncertain in notes.
Notes expanded: era is assumed to be NS, the number of the 'samvat' year is incomplete, and Kubjikāmata is a text title, not a person.

purpose: for the liberation (mokṣārtha) of the brāhmaṇa Rāmārādhya
notes: The first digit of the year is lost (⊗). The catalogue reconstructs it as (9)92 with a question mark, so ce_approx 1872 is uncertain: a lost 8 would give NS 892 = 1772 CE. The colophon just says 'samvat'. NS is assumed because the script is Newari and the catalogue reads it that way. 'brāhmana-rāma-ārāḍhya' could also be split as the name Rāma plus the epithet/title ārādhya ('worshipful'; also a brahmin group name), with brāhmaṇa as the caste. The colophon names no scribe. 'Kubjikāmata' is part of the text title, not a person.
